questions.text: How does the RA 9266 IRR define continuing professional development?

options.text: A sustaining and progressive learning process that maintains, enhances, or increases architects' knowledge and ability
A marketing event for design firms

questions.rationale: The IRR definition connects CPD to continuing professional learning and competence.
questions.explanation: Falsely exempts government employees; civil service employment does not override PIC renewal requirements. Falsely exempts consultants; consulting status does not waive PIC renewal mandates. Incorrectly grants a grace period; practice without current PIC is illegal immediately upon expiration. Active PIC status is essential for legal architectural practice; an architect without a valid, renewed PIC cannot legally practice architecture or sign documents. Valid PIC status is universally required for legal architectural practice, regardless of employment type or project scope.

questions.text: Who develops the CPD program for architects under the checked IRR source?

options.text: The integrated and accredited professional organization for architects

questions.rationale: The IRR places CPD program development with the integrated and accredited professional organization.

options.text: By being hired by a developer

questions.rationale: The IRR allows other entities as CPD providers upon Board accreditation.

questions.text: What professional document is described as subject to periodic renewal for three years?
questions.rationale: The IRR describes the PIC as subject to periodic renewal for three years.

questions.text: What must a person have before practicing architecture or using the architect title in the Philippines?

options.text: A Certificate of Registration and Professional Identification Card

questions.rationale: The RA 9266 IRR requires COR and PIC authority for practice and title use.
questions.explanation: Undercounts the track structure; three tracks would not provide the breadth required across technical, ethics, management, environmental, and specialized domains. Undercounts by one; the actual structure comprises five, not four, distinct track areas. Overcounts the track categories; seven exceeds the five-track framework. CPD activities are organized into five major areas under Professional Track category to ensure comprehensive professional development across diverse knowledge domains. CPD is organized into five major professional track categories covering diverse knowledge areas.

questions.text: What information must architects indicate on documents they sign, use, or issue in practice?
questions.rationale: The checked IRR source requires COR, PIC, and PTR details on practice documents.
questions.explanation: Contradicts the mandatory requirement; automatic renewal without compliance does not occur. Inadequate remedy; written explanation alone does not substitute for actual CPD completion. Provides unauthorized grace period; renewal cycles follow statutory timelines without extension. Failure to meet the 45-unit requirement results in PIC renewal denial until requirements are satisfied; the card cannot be renewed without proof of compliance. Non-compliance blocks PIC renewal entirely until the 45-unit requirement is fulfilled.

questions.text: Why is CPD more than attendance in the RA 9266 IRR framing?

options.text: It is only a social networking activity
It is continuing learning aimed at maintaining and increasing professional knowledge and ability

questions.rationale: The source definition gives CPD a professional competence purpose.

questions.text: What is the practice-authority risk of treating PIC renewal as optional?

options.text: No risk exists if the architect has clients
Practice and title use require current COR and PIC authority under the IRR
Only the school record is affected

questions.rationale: The IRR links lawful practice and title use to COR and PIC.
questions.explanation: Misinterprets distribution as an increase mechanism; the 45-unit total remains constant regardless of distribution across tracks. Contradicts the purpose; distribution ensures specialists maintain breadth, not elimination of depth. Incorrectly assumes distribution reduces total credits; the 45-unit requirement is unchanged. Distribution across five tracks prevents narrow focus on preferred subjects while ensuring balanced professional development across essential competencies. Track distribution prevents overspecialization and ensures architects develop competency across all five essential professional areas.
